name: Meinhard Benn
description: Meinhard Benn is a developer and entrepreneur working on decentralized infrastructure and peer-to-peer systems. He started working with Bitcoin in 2011 and founded SatoshiPay in 2014, pioneering web micropayments. He is now building Freedom Browser, an open-source browser that integrates Swarm, IPFS, Radicle, and ENS as native capabilities. His work focuses on making censorship-resistant infrastructure usable in everyday products.
